note: Main math track. Edit this file freely: scripts/cambridge/scrape.mjs refreshes only links, site text (siteTitle, siteTopics, stepQuestions) and verified flags, and never deletes an edit. Hints and solutions stay hidden behind the 60-minute cold timer in the UI.

phases.name: Gap check
phases.do: Try Assignment 1 cold. If the warm-up blocks, fix only that gap: the Khan Academy topic, then the matching Underground Mathematics station.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.do: 6 blocks. For each block, do its Underground Mathematics stations first (about 1 week), then the block's assignments.

items.title: Assignment 1
items.siteTopics: This module involves some algebraic manipulation and some work on quadratic equations. There is also a geometry question with a surprising result.

links.label: Hints file: Hints and partial solutions for Assignment 1
Working through solution to 2005 STEP 1 Question 3 - STEP Support Programme Assignment 1

items.title: Assignment 2
items.siteTopics: This module involves some more algebra, graph sketching and finding the maximum and minimum values of some functions.

links.label: Working through solution to 1999 STEP 1 Question 6 - STEP Support Programme Assignment 2

items.title: Assignment 3
items.siteTopics: This module involves some series work, an introduction to the "floor" function and a linear Diophantine equation.

links.label: Working through solution to 2004 STEP 1 Question 2 - STEP Support Programme Assignment 3

items.title: Assignment 4
items.siteTopics: This module includes a proof of a circle theorem, sketching inequalities in 2 variables and a couple of logic puzzles.

items.title: Assignment 5
items.siteTopics: This module involves some trigonometry and a question about a tetrahedron (and a question about socks!).

items.title: Assignment 6
items.siteTopics: This module covers arrangements and some problems with probability, including the "Prosecutor's fallacy".

items.title: Assignment 7

links.label: STEP Support Programme Assignment 7 (2002 STEP 1 Question 5) - video worked solution

items.title: Assignment 8
items.siteTopics: This module introduces the AM-GM inequality and the intersections of circles and ellipses.

items.title: Assignment 9
items.siteTopics: This module includes some proofs involving triangles and sketching cubics.

links.label: STEP Support Programme Assignment 9 (1993 STEP 1 Question 7) - video solution

items.title: Assignment 10
items.siteTopics: This module derives some of the compound trigonometry formula ($\sin(\alpha + \beta)$ etc.) and introduces a new function.

items.title: Assignment 11
items.siteTopics: This module includes some functions defined in a way you may not have seen before, and several equations (most of which can be solved with carefully chosen substitutions).

links.label: STEP Support Programme Foundation Assignment 11 (2013 STEP 1 Q1)

items.title: Assignment 12
items.siteTopics: This module includes proving divisibility of some expressions, probability and a puzzle which on first reading seems to be unsolvable.

links.label: STEP Support Programme Assignment 12 (2011 Step 1 Q12)

items.title: Assignment 13
items.siteTopics: This module practises sketching graphs including consideration of whether they are convex or concave, and using these to determine how many roots of an equation there are.

links.label: STEP Support Programme Assignment 13 (2012 STEP 1 Q 2)

items.siteTopics: This module includes some useful factorisation results, and some work with Fibonacci numbers.
